#   (2) LinkedIn post        output/linkedin_post.txt + output/linkedin_check.txt (section B)
#   (3) technical note, 2-3 pages A4, brief.pdf (format: typst, section C): the place for more detail
# Every number comes from output/key_numbers.csv through kn(); an unknown key stops the render.
title: "How far did Indonesia's cooking-oil price move away from its usual link to world palm oil prices during the 2022 export curbs?"
description: "Over January-May 2022 as a whole, the data show no clear shift; the gap narrowed while retail caps applied and widened once packaged-oil caps were lifted."
author: "Pietro Sala"
date: "2026-11-26"
categories: ["Region: SE Asia", "Method: Time series", "Theme: WB"]
image: output/fig1_hero.png           # listing thumbnail + open-graph image
draft: true                           # set to false to publish
title-block-banner: true
params:
  linkedin_max_chars: 1300
  linkedin_hook_max_chars: 210        # approx. text visible before "...see more" on mobile
  strict: false                       # true = stop the render if LinkedIn limits are exceeded
format:
  html:
    toc: false
    format-links: false
  typst:
    output-file: brief                # -> brief.pdf
    papersize: a4
    margin:
      x: 1.7cm

    fontsize: 11pt
    fig-format: png
    keep-typ: false
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false

```{r}
#| label: guard
#| include: false
# Before the analysis has been run there are no results: stop knitting here, so the
# website build on GitHub does not fail while a case is still in progress.
if (!file.exists("output/key_numbers.csv")) knitr::knit_exit("*Results pending.*")
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(acutils)
  library(yaml)
})
meta    <- yaml::read_yaml("00_meta.yml", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
kn_file <- "output/key_numbers.csv"
k <- function(key, ...) acutils::kn(key, file = kn_file, ...)   # formatted key number
kn_tbl  <- acutils::kn_read(kn_file)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || identical(a, "")) b else a
bold_first <- function(x) unname(vapply(x, function(s) {   # PDF: bold the first sentence, or its lead clause if long
  sent <- sub("^(.+?[.:])( .*|)$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
  lead <- sent
  if (length(strsplit(sent, " ")[[1]]) > 16) {
    cl <- sub("^(.+?[,;])( .*|)$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    if (cl != s) lead <- cl
  }
  paste0("**", lead, "**", substring(s, nchar(lead) + 1))
}, ""))
bullets  <- function(x) cat(paste0("- ", x), sep = "\n")
site_url <- "https://mithril-metrics.github.io"   # same for both authors
case_id  <- meta$id %||% basename(getwd())
blog_url <- meta$links$blog %||% paste0(site_url, "/cases/", case_id, "/report.html")
code_url <- meta$links$code %||% paste0("https://github.com/Mithril-Metrics/mithril-metrics.github.io/tree/main/cases/", case_id)
```

```{r}
#| label: shared-text
#| include: false
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WRITE HERE ONCE. These strings feed the blog, the technical note (PDF) and the LinkedIn post.
# Note-only strings (more detail than the blog): method_detail, robustness, references.
pct <- function(key, ...) paste0(k(key, ...), "%")
ci <- function(lo, hi) paste0("95% CI ", pct(lo), " to ", pct(hi))
method_detail <- paste0(
  "**We compare Indonesia's national retail cooking-oil price with the level its usual relationship with the world crude ",
  "palm oil price in rupiah would predict, and estimate how far it moved away from that level in each phase of the 2022 measures.** ",
  "*Data.* BPS national retail price of palm cooking oil (IDR per litre) and the Oil World crude palm oil price c.i.f. Rotterdam ",
  "in rupiah, monthly, November 2020 to July 2026 (", k("n_months"), " months), from FAO GIEWS FPMA; wheat flour against US ",
  "hard red winter wheat as a placebo. ",
  "*Model.* Log retail price on log world price at lags 0-2, dummies for January-May 2022, June 2022 onwards and the January 2023 ",
  "change in the BPS sample (90 to 150 districts), and an Eid month dummy; errors follow an AR(1) process estimated by maximum ",
  "likelihood; a planned split separates January-March from April-May. ",
  "*Inference.* 95% intervals; Holm adjustment across the three phase terms. ",
  "*Identification.* The comparison assumes that, given world prices, nothing other than the 2022 measures moved the gap in ",
  "January-May 2022. The data partly reject this: the gap was already widening in late 2021, and the measures themselves moved ",
  "the world price."
)
results_note <- c(
  paste0("**Over January-May 2022 the shift is not clear:** ", pct("main_window_pct", sign = TRUE), " (",
         ci("main_window_lo", "main_window_hi"), "; Holm-adjusted p = ", k("main_window_p_holm"), "). With AR(1) errors (coefficient ",
         k("ar1_main"), ") the estimate weights January 2022 by ", k("w_window_jan2022"), " and December 2021 by ",
         k("w_window_dec2021"), ", so it mainly measures the jump at the start of the window."),
  paste0("**April-May 2022 shows a shift of ", pct("r1_window_b_pct", sign = TRUE), "** (", ci("r1_window_b_lo", "r1_window_b_hi"),
         "), about Rp", k("r1_window_b_idr"), " per litre at 2021 prices; January-March shows ", pct("r1_window_a_pct", sign = TRUE),
         " (", ci("r1_window_a_lo", "r1_window_a_hi"), ")."),
  paste0("**Month by month, the gap fell ", k("s6_feb_minus_jan_pp", abs = TRUE), " points in February 2022 and rose ",
         k("s6_apr_minus_mar_pp"), " points in April;** it moved ", k("s6_may_minus_apr_pp", sign = TRUE),
         " points in May, the month of the export ban, and narrowed by ", k("s6_aug_minus_jun_pp", abs = TRUE),
         " points between June and August."),
  paste0("**After June 2022 the level is model-dependent:** ", pct("main_post_pct", sign = TRUE), " (", ci("main_post_lo", "main_post_hi"),
         ") in the main model and ", pct("r1_post_pct", sign = TRUE), " (", ci("r1_post_lo", "r1_post_hi"), ") in the split model.")
)
robustness <- c(
  paste0("**Weighting months equally gives a larger window shift:** OLS with Newey-West errors ", pct("main_window_ols_pct", sign = TRUE),
         "; the raw difference in mean gaps against November 2020 - December 2021 is ", pct("desc_window_minus_pre_pct", sign = TRUE),
         "; with a constant shift these would agree with the AR(1) estimate."),
  paste0("**The gap moved before the 2022 measures:** a dummy for October-December 2021 gives ", pct("s4_pre3_pct", sign = TRUE),
         " (", ci("s4_pre3_lo", "s4_pre3_hi"), ") and lifts the window estimate to ", pct("s4_window_pct", sign = TRUE), "."),
  paste0("**Timing matters for the phase estimates:** moving all phases by one month gives ", pct("s7_lag1_window_pct", sign = TRUE),
         " for the window and ", pct("s7_lag1_window_b_pct", sign = TRUE), " for April-May; by two months, ",
         pct("s7_lag2_window_pct", sign = TRUE), ". Each shifted estimate mainly compares its new first month with the month before."),
  paste0("**The April-May shift does not hinge on the world-price link:** ", pct("s1_window_b_pct", sign = TRUE),
         " with lags 0-5; ", pct("s3_window_b_min"), " to ", pct("s3_window_b_max"), " for imposed pass-through of 0.1 to 0.9; ",
         "estimating the link without 2022 (pass-through ", k("passthrough_ex2022"), " instead of ", k("passthrough_sum"),
         ") leaves the April-May gap at ", pct("gap_aprmay_ex2022_pct"), "."),
  paste0("**Fake windows elsewhere rarely move this much:** none of ", k("s5_n2"), " two-month windows outside January-May 2022 ",
         "exceeds ", pct("s5_max2"), ", but most fall in the calm months after 2022."),
  paste0("**The placebo is weak:** wheat flour barely follows world wheat (pass-through ", k("flour_passthrough_sum"),
         ", AR(1) ", k("flour_ar1"), ") and shifts ", pct("placebo_window_pct", sign = TRUE), " in the window (p = ",
         k("placebo_window_p"), "), so it cannot rule out shocks common to food prices.")
)
references <- c(
  "Cabinet Secretariat of Indonesia (2022). Govt rolls out one-price cooking oil policy. 19 January. [setkab.go.id](https://setkab.go.id/en/govt-rolls-out-one-price-cooking-oil-policy/)",
  "Cabinet Secretariat of Indonesia (2022). Govt strengthens measures to maintain cooking oil price. 28 January. [setkab.go.id](https://setkab.go.id/en/govt-strengthens-measures-to-maintain-cooking-oil-price)",
  "Ombudsman RI (2022). Temuan Ombudsman soal minyak goreng. 8 February. [ombudsman.go.id](https://ombudsman.go.id/news/download/temuan-ombudsman-soal-minyak-goreng-penimbunan-hingga-pengalihan-ke-pasar-tradisional)",
  "The Jakarta Post (2022). Indonesia raises palm oil export levies. 19 March. [thejakartapost.com](https://www.thejakartapost.com/business/2022/03/19/indonesia-raises-palm-oil-export-levies.html)",
  "Al Jazeera (2022). Indonesian farmers decry palm oil export ban as prices plummet. 16 May. [aljazeera.com](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2022/5/16/indonesian-farmers-decry-palm-oil-export-ban-as-prices-plummet)",
  "Katadata (2022). Tiga pekan larangan ekspor CPO, harga minyak goreng curah dekati HET. 19 May. [katadata.co.id](https://katadata.co.id/berita/industri/6285dba47b70b/tiga-pekan-larangan-ekspor-cpo-harga-minyak-goreng-curah-dekati-het)",
  "Dawn / Reuters (2022). Indonesia removes palm oil export levy until Aug 31. 17 July. [dawn.com](https://dawn.com/news/1700027/indonesia-removes-palm-oil-export-levy-until-aug-31)",
  "Putra, A. and Patunru, A. (2024). Export restrictions and domestic palm oil prices in Indonesia. *Journal of Southeast Asian Economies* (abstract). [ANU repository](https://openresearch-repository.anu.edu.au/entities/publication/1f59aa80-c10d-409f-8d2f-0fdf517af3b5)",
  "PwC Indonesia (2026). Legal Alert 2026-67. August. [pwc.com](https://www.pwc.com/id/en/pwc-publications/services-publications/legal-publications/legal-alert-2026-67.html)",
  "RRI (2026). Indonesia's future of palm oil exports after new ministerial regulation. 10 June. [rri.co.id](https://rri.co.id/en/national/2480326/indonesias-future-of-palm-oil-exports-after-new-ministerial-regulation)"
)
# Use k("key") for every number (k("key", unit = TRUE) adds the unit, abs = TRUE drops sign).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
question <- meta$question

bottom_line <- paste0(
  "Over January-May 2022 as a whole, our pre-specified test finds no clear shift in Indonesia's retail ",
  "cooking-oil price relative to its usual link with world palm oil (", pct("main_window_pct", sign = TRUE), ", ",
  ci("main_window_lo", "main_window_hi"), "). Split as planned, January-March shows no clear shift (",
  pct("r1_window_a_pct", sign = TRUE), ") and April-May ", pct("r1_window_b_pct", sign = TRUE),
  " (about Rp", k("r1_window_b_idr"), " per litre at 2021 prices), after the caps on packaged oil were lifted ",
  "in mid-March; monthly data cannot separate this from other shocks."
)

why_now <- paste0(
  "Indonesia's Trade Regulation 16/2026 routes crude palm oil exports through a single state-owned exporter: ",
  "a transition from June to December 2026, and the state exporter as sole exporter of record from 1 January 2027. ",
  "**The last time the government administered export flows was 2022**, when a one-price policy, a domestic supply ",
  "obligation, retail caps, an export quota, higher export levies and a four-week export ban followed each other ",
  "within five months. The 2027 scheme changes export channels rather than banning exports, so 2022 is only a partial analogue."
)

method_plain <- paste0(
  "**We ask how far the national retail price moved away from the level its usual relationship with world palm oil ",
  "would predict, in each phase of the 2022 measures, allowing for the fact that price gaps carry over from month to month.** ",
  "We use ", k("n_months"), " months of BPS national retail prices (November 2020 to July 2026) and world crude palm oil ",
  "prices in rupiah, from FAO's price monitoring database. Retail cooking oil normally passes on about a third of a ",
  "world-price change within three months (elasticity ", k("passthrough_sum"), "), so we compare with that link, not with ",
  "world prices: in January-May 2022 world palm oil in rupiah was ",
  pct("cpo_window_vs_2021_pct"), " above its 2021 average and retail cooking oil ", pct("vegoil_window_vs_2021_pct"),
  ". The January-May test and its split into January-March and April-May were fixed before we saw results; ",
  "later checks are labelled exploratory."
)

implications <- c(
  paste0("If the aim of administering exports is lower domestic prices, **the 2022 record gives no evidence that national ",
         "average retail prices fall relative to their usual world-price link.** Farmers reported fresh-fruit-bunch prices ",
         "roughly halving during the ban ",
         "([Al Jazeera, 16 May 2022](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2022/5/16/indonesian-farmers-decry-palm-oil-export-ban-as-prices-plummet)); ",
         "we do not measure producer effects."),
  paste0("If retail caps are the instrument, the recorded gap narrowed only while caps applied and widened within weeks ",
         "of lifting them. The trade-off is availability: in February 2022 the national average was ",
         pct("vegoil_feb2022_vs_cap_pct"), " above the highest cap in force, consistent with the shortages the ",
         "[Ombudsman reported](https://ombudsman.go.id/news/download/temuan-ombudsman-soal-minyak-goreng-penimbunan-hingga-pengalihan-ke-pasar-tradisional) ",
         "in February, though we do not test this."),
  paste0("If the aim is to monitor the 2027 scheme, national monthly averages cannot separate measures that are weeks ",
         "apart; weekly prices by province and by product type (bulk vs packaged) would.")
)

caveats <- c(
  "The 2022 measures came within weeks of each other; **monthly data cannot isolate any one of them**, and January is partly treated.",
  paste0("The series is a national average that sat well above every cap (Rp", k("vegoil_feb2022"), " per litre in February 2022); ",
         "it does not show the price of capped oil, how much households could buy or regional differences (bulk oil cost ",
         "Rp14,250 to Rp29,250 per kg across provinces in May 2022, ",
         "[Katadata](https://katadata.co.id/berita/industri/6285dba47b70b/tiga-pekan-larangan-ekspor-cpo-harga-minyak-goreng-curah-dekati-het))."),
  "Indonesia's own measures moved the world palm oil price used as the benchmark, so in 2022 the predicted level is not a policy-free comparison.",
  "The January-May estimate depends on how months are weighted and where the phase boundaries fall, so it cannot rule out a shift in either direction.",
  "One country and one episode; the result does not predict the effect of the 2027 state-exporter scheme."
)

caveats_note <- c(caveats,                       # technical note: the post's five first, then the rest
  "The post-2022 level depends on the model and on how the 2023 BPS sample change is treated; it is the least reliable number.",
  "An export quota (9 March 2022), a higher export-levy ceiling (mid-March) and a levy suspension (July-August 2022) fall in the same months.",
  "Which oil types (bulk, MinyaKita, packaged) the national series averages, especially before 2022, could not be confirmed.",
  "Ramadan 2022 fell in April; other Ramadan months show no jump in the gap, but a demand effect cannot be excluded.",
  "IDR per litre figures are at 2021 prices; at early-2022 prices the same percentage is about a fifth larger."
)

findings <- c(                                   # LinkedIn arrows
  paste0("Jan-May 2022 as a whole: ", pct("main_window_pct", sign = TRUE), ", not clearly different from zero"),
  paste0("Apr-May 2022, after packaged-oil caps were lifted: ", pct("r1_window_b_pct", sign = TRUE),
         ", about Rp", k("r1_window_b_idr"), " per litre"),
  paste0("Late 2021, before the 2022 measures: the gap had already widened by about ", pct("s4_pre3_pct"))
)

hero_alt <- paste0("Bar chart of the monthly gap between Indonesia's national retail cooking-oil price and the price predicted ",
                   "from world palm oil, November 2020 to July 2026. The gap is negative in early 2021, turns positive in late 2021, ",
                   "falls close to zero in February and March 2022, peaks at about ", pct("gap_aprmay_pct"), " on average in April and May 2022, ",
                   "and settles at a smaller positive level afterwards.")

key_figures <- list(
  c(value = pct("main_window_pct", sign = TRUE), label = "Jan-May 2022, pre-specified test (not clear)"),
  c(value = pct("r1_window_b_pct", sign = TRUE), label = "Apr-May 2022, planned split"),
  c(value = paste0("Rp", k("r1_window_b_idr")), label = "Apr-May shift per litre, 2021 prices"),
  c(value = pct("s4_pre3_pct", sign = TRUE), label = "Oct-Dec 2021, before the 2022 measures (exploratory)")
)

author_slug <- gsub("[^a-z]+", "-", tolower(iconv(rmarkdown::metadata$author %||% "", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")))

method_tag <- "Method: interrupted time series with AR(1) errors on FAO GIEWS monthly prices, Nov 2020 - Jul 2026"
hashtags   <- "#FoodPolicy #PalmOil #Indonesia #AgriculturalEconomics"

## What the data show

### The gap widened sharply after packaged-oil caps were lifted

![](output/fig1_hero.png){fig-alt="`r hero_alt`" width="100%"}

**Split as planned, January-March 2022 shows no clear shift (`r pct("r1_window_a_pct", sign = TRUE)`), while April-May shows `r pct("r1_window_b_pct", sign = TRUE)` (`r ci("r1_window_b_lo", "r1_window_b_hi")`), about Rp`r k("r1_window_b_idr")` per litre at 2021 prices.** April came after the caps on packaged oil were lifted on 16 March and mostly before the export ban of 28 April. In an exploratory check, no two-month window elsewhere in the series shows a shift above `r pct("s5_max2")`.

### Over January-May as a whole, the answer depends on how months are weighted

![](output/figB_phase_effects.png){fig-alt="Point estimates with 95 percent intervals: January to May 2022 (pre-specified), January to March and April to May 2022 (planned split), from June 2022, and the wheat flour placebo. Only April to May lies clearly above zero." width="100%"}

**The pre-specified estimate is `r pct("main_window_pct", sign = TRUE)` (`r ci("main_window_lo", "main_window_hi")`), but it mainly compares January 2022 with December 2021.** Because price gaps carry over from month to month, the model weights January by `r k("w_window_jan2022")` and December 2021 by `r k("w_window_dec2021")`, and no other month by more than `r k("w_window_other_max")`. By December the gap had already widened by about `r pct("s4_pre3_pct")` (`r ci("s4_pre3_lo", "s4_pre3_hi")`, exploratory), before any of the 2022 measures. Weighting the five months equally gives `r pct("main_window_ols_pct", sign = TRUE)`, and moving the phase boundaries by one month gives `r pct("s7_lag1_window_pct", sign = TRUE)` (both exploratory). We therefore read the pre-specified result as "not clear", not as "no effect".

### Month by month, the moves line up with the caps

![](output/fig2_event_months.png){fig-alt="Monthly estimates with 95 percent intervals from October 2021 to December 2022. The estimate drops in February 2022, jumps in April 2022 and declines gradually from June onwards." width="100%"}

**In an exploratory month-by-month check, the gap fell `r k("s6_feb_minus_jan_pp", abs = TRUE)` points in February 2022, the first full month of retail caps, and rose `r k("s6_apr_minus_mar_pp")` points in April.** In May, when the export ban fell, it moved `r k("s6_may_minus_apr_pp", sign = TRUE)` points. The timing matches the caps but does not show that they caused the moves, and a four-week ban may not show in monthly averages.

hooks_alt <- c(
  paste0("Did Indonesia's 2022 palm oil export curbs lower cooking-oil prices? Over January-May as a whole, our test cannot tell (",
         pct("main_window_pct", sign = TRUE), ", interval ", pct("main_window_lo"), " to ", pct("main_window_hi"), ")."),
  paste0("Five cooking-oil measures in five months: Indonesia, 2022. Monthly prices can show when the gap moved, ",
         "but not which measure moved it.")
)
why_li <- paste0("From January 2027 Indonesia will export crude palm oil only through a state-owned exporter. ",
                 "The last time export flows were managed was 2022.")
impl_li <- paste0("If the aim of managing exports is lower domestic prices, 2022 gives no evidence that the national ",
                  "average retail price falls relative to its usual world-price link. Availability, regional prices ",
                  "and producer prices are not measured here.")
li <- paste0(
  hook, "\n\n",
  why_li, "\n\n",
  "What we found:\n", paste0("→ ", findings, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n",
  "What it means: ", impl_li, "\n\n",
  method_tag, "\n",
  "Full analysis and code: link in the first comment\n\n",
  hashtags
)
dir.create("output", showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines(li, "output/linkedin_post.txt", useBytes = TRUE)
writeLines(paste0("Full analysis and code: ", blog_url), "output/linkedin_first_comment.txt", useBytes = TRUE)
writeLines(c("Alternative hooks:", hooks_alt), "output/linkedin_hooks_alt.txt", useBytes = TRUE)
writeLines(paste("Alt text, hero figure:", hero_alt), "output/hero_alt.txt", useBytes = TRUE)

n_total <- nchar(li, type = "chars")
n_hook  <- nchar(hook, type = "chars")
checks <- c(
  sprintf("LinkedIn post: %d characters (limit %d) %s", n_total, params$linkedin_max_chars,
          if (n_total <= params$linkedin_max_chars) "OK" else "TOO LONG"),
  sprintf("Hook: %d characters (aim <= %d, approx. visible before 'see more') %s", n_hook,
          params$linkedin_hook_max_chars,
          if (n_hook <= params$linkedin_hook_max_chars) "OK" else "TOO LONG"),
  sprintf("Placeholders left: %s", if (grepl("\\[|Placeholder", li)) "YES - edit before posting" else "none")
)
writeLines(checks, "output/linkedin_check.txt")
message(paste(checks, collapse = "\n"))
too_long <- n_total > params$linkedin_max_chars || n_hook > params$linkedin_hook_max_chars
if (too_long && isTRUE(params$strict)) stop(paste(checks, collapse = "\n"))
if (too_long) warning(paste(checks, collapse = "\n"))
```
